output.reason: Highly resolved luxury perfume still-life featuring classical sculptural props and symmetrical composition; excellent design reference for opulent, heritage-driven fragrance campaigns.

analysis.composition: Symmetrical arrangement with the perfume bottle elevated on a central column, flanked by classical busts and broken pillar fragments on a seamless white background.
analysis.negative_space: Generous clean white space at the top and bottom, focusing attention entirely on the central tableau.
analysis.lighting: Soft, diffused studio lighting creating gentle gradients on the white plaster and distinct, soft shadows anchoring the columns to the floor.
analysis.typography: None outside the container; text is limited to the product label printed directly on the glass bottle.
analysis.information_density: Low; purely visual and atmospheric with no external campaign copy.
